t: Introduction and overview — Charles de Gaulle Aircraft Carrier
name: Introduction and overview — Charles de Gaulle Aircraft Carrier — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Charles de Gaulle Aircraft Carrier
description: Introduction and overview of the Charles de Gaulle Aircraft Carrier: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The French carrier Charles de Gaulle is the only nuclear-powered aircraft carrier built outside the United States: 42,500 tons operating Rafale M fighters and E-2C Hawkeyes from catapults. Commissioned in 2001, she is France's flagship and has flown combat over Afghanistan, Libya, Iraq, and Syria. Baseline facts: French nuclear carrier; 42,500 tons; Rafale M and E-2C; commissioned 2001..
